requirement.description: Async testbench functions not receiving required 'ctx' parameter
requirement.contract: Async testbench functions registered with add_testbench() must be invoked with a context parameter 'ctx'. When a testbench is registered via add_testbench(), it should be executed as an async coroutine that receives a ctx parameter allowing access to signal values via ctx.get() and setting values via ctx.set().
requirement.acceptance: All simulator regression tests in tests/test_sim.py that fail with "missing 1 required positional argument: 'ctx'" should pass. This includes: tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_abandon_delay, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_latch, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_edge, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_struct, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_sync_reset, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_timeout, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_broken_other_trigger, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_valuecastable, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_abandon_changed, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_critical, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_async_reset, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_trigger_wrong, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_sample, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_delay, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_tick_repeat_until, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_broken_multiedge, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorIntegrationTestCase::test_reset

requirement.description: Domain lookup not working in hierarchical module structures
requirement.contract: The domain lookup mechanism should correctly resolve domain references in hierarchical module structures with domain renaming. DomainRenamer should properly map domain references in complex hierarchical designs.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_hdl_ir.py::DomainLookupTestCase::test_domain_lookup should pass. The test validates correct domain resolution in complex hierarchical scenarios involving domain renaming.

requirement.description: RTLIL backend memory test cases failing due to incomplete implementation
requirement.contract: The RTLIL backend should correctly generate VCD output for memory read/write operations. Both memory test cases (test_async_read and test_sync_read) should produce valid RTLIL output.
